steps.title: Dark mode: new values, same rules
steps.look: In dark mode the tokens get new values, and no rule changes. color-scheme turns the email field dark too. But the links are still #8a1c1c, now on #14161f: 1.94:1, far under 4.5:1. (The preview shows the dark values; in your copy, use DevTools → Rendering → prefers-color-scheme.)

steps.title: Focus you can see
steps.look: a:focus { outline: none } hid the keyboard's cursor. :focus-visible draws a 3px accent outline, 9.12:1 on the light background and 8.85:1 on the dark one. Click into the preview and press Tab.

steps.title: Cards with a picture: :has() and nesting
steps.look: .card:has(img) puts the poster in a narrow column beside the words, and the card with no picture stays as it was. The & rules sit inside .card, one level deep.
